caption: The drawing depicts a clear glass tumbler set against a plain, lightly colored background. The tumbler has the words "CRYSTAL PALACE 1851" in gold-colored lettering near its upper side. The glass features a thick base, within which is a decorative, circular element colored with shades of purple, pink, and blue, radiating from a central, round blue dot encircled by smaller blue dots and a ring of white dots. The lines and shading indicate reflections and transparency consistent with glass. The overall composition centers the tumbler on the page, with the decorative base as a prominent feature at the bottom.
title: Tumbler
